name: – Isabel Wiseler-Lima – After recital J – Am 67
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: Ja. whereas international humanitarian law, including the Geneva Conventions, mandates the humane treatment of prisoners of war, ensuring their rights to dignity, medical care and communication with their families; whereas numerous reports from international organisations, human rights groups, journalists and Ukrainian authorities provide evidence of executions of Ukrainian prisoners of war by Russian forces; whereas those held are subjected to severe mistreatment, including torture, forced labour, psychological abuse and inhumane detention conditions; whereas Russia’s systematic violations of these legal obligations constitute war crimes under international law;
